course.title: Legal Basis of Planning
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: a. Discuss the Statutes & Enforcement Authorities involved in Land (10) Administration and Management in the process of Acquisition of land.
b. Make a list of maps and plans necessary to attach with the application (10) for the approval of private housing project.
C. Critically examine and analyze different rules for Building Construction in (15) different countries.
